games.desc:
- THE CAT IN THE HAT HAS ARRIVED...

🕰️ Every round starts with a timer.

Survive until it reaches zero, or complete puzzles to shorten it.

They were forgotten.

Now they want you dead.

At 3 minutes, they get worse:

💢 ENRAGED KENDRICK – Stronger and faster.
⚡ SCP-067 – Weaker, but extremely fast.
🥭 MANGO GOD – Strong and able to throw mangos.
🎩 The Cat – Extremely intelligent and strong.

Each one hunts differently.

Stay alive until the clock hits zero.

🎮 Controls
Shift – Sprint
F – Flashlight
Ctrl – Crouch
Q – Whistle
R – Push
X – Backpack
Alt – Unlock Cursor
